intro: Since the fall of the Assad government in December 2024, Syria has been run by a transitional government.

chapters.title: Transition
text: Ahmed al-Sharaa, leader of the rebel group that took Damascus, became interim president. A temporary constitution was announced in 2025, and the government is trying to unite a divided country and rebuild.

chapters.title: The old system
text: Under the Assads, Syria was a one-party state run by the Baath Party, with feared security services.

keyTerms.meaning: A temporary government after big political change.
The party that ruled Syria from 1963 to 2024.

items.title: Interim rules
